Radar hack overview

Radar hack on [Lite tier](/products/fortnite-cheats/) extends Fortnite camera distance beyond the default cap—supports track off-screen fights, aim duelists watch loot contests, and rotators spot hostile players earlier.
Module lives in the utility tab with dynamic zoom and angle lock options—enable before launching Fortnite Games.
Extended camera setup
Enable radar hack in the loader utility tab before launching Fortnite. Set max zoom to 130–150% of default first—push higher only after you adapt to radar timing.
Bind scroll wheel or hotkey for temporary zoom-out during squad fights without permanent max zoom in lane.
Dynamic zoom
Dynamic zoom auto-scales camera when multiple enemies enter vision radius—tight in lane, wide in 5v5. Reduces manual scroll spam during chaotic fights.
Disable dynamic zoom in instances if fights chain too fast and disorient you—ranked team fights benefit more than instances skirmishes.
Angle lock for supports
Angle lock keeps camera tilt consistent when zooming—prevents seasick drift on high zoom. Supports guarding safelane benefit most.
Set lock before laning phase and avoid mid-fight adjustments. Aim duelists may prefer free tilt for loot contest angles.
Pair with ESP wallhack
Radar hack complements chest ESP and stealth alerts from [ESP wallhack setup](/blog/fortnite-esp-wallhack-setup/)—camera range plus enemy dots beats either alone.

Stream and capture notes
Zoom changes are client-side camera—stream-proof mode hides ESP overlays, not zoom extension. Test OBS capture if viewers comment on camera behavior.
